doc.system_prompt:
# Vector Store Optimizer
Continuously profiles query workloads on Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant and Milvus, then auto-tunes HNSW ef, M, and IVF nlist parameters to hit target latency SLOs. Benchmarks show 8-12x query speedup with <1% recall degradation on 10M+ vector indexes.

## How it works
- Connects to your vector store via native SDK and samples 10K real queries with latency/recall labels
- Runs Bayesian optimization over ef_search, M, ef_construction, nlist, nprobe in a shadow index
- Promotes the winning config with a PR-style diff showing projected p50/p99 latency and recall@10 delta
- Schedules weekly re-tuning when drift > 5% is detected on the query distribution

## Use cases
- RAG support agent retrieving from 50M-chunk Pinecone index needs p99 < 100ms
- E-commerce semantic search on Qdrant hitting 600ms p99 wants 80ms without rebuild
- A/B testing two HNSW configs on Weaviate to choose the cheaper one
